globalNotes: Dark theme throughout, near-black background (#0E1419 / #12181E) with a subtle vertical gradient (slightly lighter at top, darker at bottom). All header/label text is uppercase white or muted grey, condensed/heavy sans-serif (WHOOP's Proxima-like font). This is a Trend View detail screen reached by tapping a metric on the home/overview. Top status bar shows iOS system UI (09:38, silenced-bell icon, cellular 2/4 bars, wifi, battery 38%). A floating circular WHOOP Coach button (gradient blue/purple ring with W mark) overlaps the bottom-right — EXCLUDED. Screen scrolls; one more partial card peeks at the very bottom edge below the visible content.

layout.name: Status bar
layout.description: iOS system status bar. Left: time '09:38' in white bold. A silenced/muted bell icon immediately right of the time. Right cluster: cellular signal bars (2 of 4 filled), wifi glyph, battery pill showing '38' with white fill at ~38%.

layout.name: Screen header / nav bar
layout.description: Centered uppercase title 'TREND VIEW' in white, bold, letter-spaced, ~17px. A back chevron '<' (left-pointing caret) at far left in white. No right-side action.
layout.interaction: Back chevron navigates back to the previous (home/overview) screen.

layout.name: Metric selector dropdown
layout.description: Full-width rounded rectangle (~16px radius) with a slightly lighter grey gradient fill (#2A323A to #1E252C). Left: a dumbbell/barbell icon (outline, grey-white). Center-left: 'STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME' in white, bold, uppercase, letter-spaced, ~18px. Far right: a downward chevron 'v' in white indicating a dropdown.
layout.interaction: Tapping opens a dropdown/picker to switch which trend metric is displayed.

layout.name: AVG. WEEKLY TOTAL stat block
layout.description: Left-aligned. Small muted-grey uppercase label 'AVG. WEEKLY TOTAL' (~13px, #8A929A). Below it a very large white value '0:00' (heavy, ~56px) with a smaller white 'hr' unit suffix baseline-aligned to its right (~22px).

layout.name: Time-range segmented toggle
layout.description: Top-right, a rounded dark pill (#1A2026) segmented into three options: 'W', 'M', '6M'. 'M' is selected, shown as a raised lighter-grey rounded button (#3A424A) with white text; 'W' and '6M' are unselected, muted grey text on the dark pill. Each is bold uppercase ~16px.
layout.interaction: Tapping W / M / 6M switches the trend window between Weekly, Monthly, and 6-Month views, re-loading the chart and date range. Currently 'M' active.

layout.name: Date-range stepper
layout.description: Below the toggle, right side. Centered white bold text 'JUN 3 - JUN 30, 26' (~17px) flanked by a left chevron '<' and right chevron '>' both in muted grey. Represents the currently shown month-window.
layout.interaction: Left/right chevrons page to the previous/next date window.

layout.name: Summary explanatory text
layout.description: Multi-line white body paragraph, regular weight, ~20px, left-aligned, spanning full width: 'You spent 0:00 in strength activities in the last 7 days. This is consistent with your weekly average from the last four weeks (0:00).'
literals: You spent 0:00 in strength activities in the last 7 days. This is consistent with your weekly average from the last four weeks (0:00).

layout.name: Trend chart (bar/line area)
layout.description: A trend chart occupying the mid-screen. Single left y-axis (no dual axis), time in H:MM with muted-grey gridline labels at: '0:30' (top), '0:22', '0:15', '0:07' (descending). Faint horizontal gridlines extend right from each label. X-axis labels (muted grey, bottom) are four weekly buckets: 'Jun 3 - 9', 'Jun 10 - 16', 'Jun 17 - 23', 'Jun 24 - 30'. A horizontal dashed white baseline runs across near the bottom (just above the x-axis labels) labeled with a white rounded tag 'AVG.' at its far left. No data bars/points are drawn because all values are 0:00, so the plot area is empty above the baseline. Series would be weekly strength-activity-time bars compared against the dashed AVG. line.
layout.interaction: Tapping/selecting a bar would highlight that week's value; none present here.

layout.name: Info note
layout.description: A small circled 'i' info icon (outline) at left, followed by muted grey small text: 'Strength activity time is derived from logged strength activities listed below'. ~14px, single line truncated to width.
literals: Strength activity time is derived from logged strength activities listed below

layout.name: ADD ACTIVITY button
layout.description: Full-width rounded dark card (#1A2026). Left: a '+' plus icon (grey-white). Label 'ADD ACTIVITY' in white bold uppercase, letter-spaced, ~18px. Far right: a right chevron '>' in white.
layout.interaction: Tapping opens the flow to manually add/log a strength activity.

layout.name: SET A GOAL IN WEEKLY PLAN button
layout.description: Full-width rounded dark card (#1A2026) directly below ADD ACTIVITY. Left: a clipboard-with-checkmark icon (outline, grey-white). Label 'SET A GOAL IN WEEKLY PLAN' in white bold uppercase, letter-spaced, ~18px. Right side is partly overlapped by the floating Coach button; presumably also has a chevron.
literals: SET A GOAL IN WEEKLY PLAN
layout.interaction: Tapping navigates to the Weekly Plan to set a strength-activity goal.

excluded: Floating WHOOP Coach button (circular gradient blue/purple ring with stylized 'W' mark) overlapping the bottom-right corner over the 'SET A GOAL IN WEEKLY PLAN' card — AI/coach feature, excluded from build.

charts.name: Strength Activity Time weekly trend
charts.series: Weekly strength-activity time per week bucket (no bars rendered because every week is 0:00); compared to a horizontal dashed white AVG. baseline
charts.yAxis: Time H:MM, single left axis. Gridline labels top-to-bottom: 0:30, 0:22, 0:15, 0:07
charts.notes: Dashed white horizontal AVG. line near bottom with a white rounded 'AVG.' tag at far left. No data points/bars or on-point annotations are visible (all values 0:00). Single y-axis (not dual). Faint horizontal gridlines at each y label.
